data_provenance: NTA/NMC NEET UG pattern as used in 2025–2026 sessions: Physics 50 printed (35 Section A compulsory + 15 Section B attempt-any-10), Chemistry same 50/45 scored, Biology 100 printed (70 + 30 attempt-any-20) → 90 scored. All single-correct MCQs (+4/−1). Confirm against current NTA information bulletin before production use.
important_caveat: NTA can revise section counts or the Section B choice rule. Prefer seeded ExamPaperPattern documents when present; this file is the seed source for 2026.

exam_day.note: NEET UG is a single computer-based paper (Physics + Chemistry + Biology). Botany/Zoology are coaching/bank splits of the one Biology section, not separate NTA papers.

section_1_single_correct.note: Per Physics/Chemistry scored count (35 Section A + best 10 of 15 Section B). Biology scored = 90.

marking.section_b_note: Physics/Chemistry: attempt any 10 of 15; Biology: attempt any 20 of 30. Best attempted count toward score.

Botany.note: Bank split of Biology; not a separate NTA section

Zoology.note: Bank split of Biology; not a separate NTA section

question_types_note: NEET uses only single-correct MCQs. No numerical-value (JEE Main), multi-correct, or matrix-match (JEE Advanced).
